name: ederson-agencia
description: Agência freelancer Ederson Programador — landing, contratos e portal com login.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && concurrently -n web,api,crm -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:local-api --workspace @ederson-agencia/web" "npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/api" "npm run dev:crm"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run dev --workspace @ederson-agencia/api
scripts.dev:crm: cross-env PORT=3010 CRM_HMR_CLIENT_PORT=5174 npm --prefix apps/amplifica-crm run dev
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/web && node scripts/vercel-postbuild.mjs
scripts.build:api:render: npm run build --workspace=@ederson-agencia/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@ederson-agencia/api && npm run build --workspace=@ederson-agencia/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.sync:tanar: npm run build --workspace @ederson-agencia/api && npm run sync:tanar --workspace @ederson-agencia/api
